prompt.title: Which color do you prefer: red, green or blue?

notes: OpenCode's question tool dialog (footer '↑↓ select  enter submit  esc dismiss'). Digits 1-9 pick an answer; for a single question the pick is submitted at once (digit 2 answered 'green'). esc dismisses (rejects) the question. Since 2026-09-25 the line under each answer is its description, and "Type your own answer" (a free-text field the watch cannot fill) is left out; the other options keep their ids.
